anchor.exact_paragraph: Avoid wide positional rows filled with consecutive empty delimiters: the real extractor can insert an extra empty field even when the semantic answer is correct. Prefer documented native scalar fields, or short tagged rows with explicit field names and only relevant optional fields. Advertise exact escaping, required fields, completion and terminal markers; reject duplicate/unknown fields and malformed sibling rows before applying decisions. Execute the literal examples copied from the advertised extraction prompt through the actual decoder, including recipient confirmation, DOB, phone suffix, heterogeneous decisions and later consent. Also exercise missing/extra separators, explicit partial answers and malformed rows. A hand-built correctly positioned helper fixture alone does not verify the producer contract. Never accept a malformed payment/consent event by trimming, shifting or dropping columns.

operations.text: Generate a compact explicit producer/consumer contract manifest with the exact kind set, keys, delimiters, value grammar, completion states and literal examples. Check that every advertised example decodes unchanged and every consumed field is advertised; keep annotations outside literal examples. Distinguish local decoder tests from actual extractor observations. Any ordinary punctuation allowed in natural dates must also be allowed by the event value grammar without stripping malformed syntax or inventing missing values. Resolve the current phase's complete primary intent with the input's precedence, retain independent administrative questions until spoken, and apply payment completion guards only to actual payment corrections.

anchor.exact_paragraph: For a structurally readable incomplete event, process the declared unfinished component before applying complete-date validation. If the producer marks the date unfinished and also emits a date fragment, that fragment cannot be used as a date or consent. Retain an independently complete, valid amount for the same target and ask only for the unfinished date; an invalid date fragment must not resurrect an older amount or expand the missing set to both components. Reject malformed structure or ambiguous target scope without a write. A later complete date still requires policy validation, a new full readback and separate confirmation. Include a delivered-event recovery probe with a complete amount beside an unfinished ordinal date, as well as faithful producer examples and malformed-event negative controls.

operations.text: Validate event structure and target scope before handling its completion state. For a readable incomplete event, classify the declared unfinished component before applying complete-value validation. Retain each independently complete valid component for that same target even when another component is unfinished; a declared unfinished date fragment is neither a usable date nor a reason to discard a complete amount. Update the correction's required set by subtracting explicit newly completed components, rather than unioning obsolete missing flags or reviving superseded offers. Preserve unaffected target facts, invalidate active readback and consent, and clarify only remaining components. Malformed structure or ambiguous scope authorizes no write. Once all required components are complete and policy-valid, speak a fresh full readback and require later clear confirmation. Validate this with the actual delivered event grammar, persistent merged state and next spoken question, including complete amount plus unfinished date and both completion orders.

anchor.exact_paragraph: Normalize complete ordinary date expressions at the producer/consumer boundary using the call's supplied date context: month names and spoken ordinals, omitted years, weekday plus day ordinal, and the policy's this/next weekday definition. Require a consistent unambiguous whole expression; never infer a date from an unfinished fragment or negate the customer's explicit date by substituting the old offered date. An acceptance of a known offered amount with a newly supplied date adopts that new date before validation and readback. Distinguish a vague period, an unreadable expression and a valid date requiring holiday/deadline adjustment. Use the policy's one exact-day clarification and fallback, rather than asking indefinitely. Preserve unsupported/ambiguous input safeguards and verify both ordinary and contradictory date examples against the actual extraction grammar.

operations.text: Keep date normalization outcomes explicit: valid exact expression, source-defined vague period, unfinished component, and invalid or conflicting complete expression. Do not silently count impossible dates or contradictory weekday/date pairs as repeated vague periods. Apply fallback and clarification limits only to the classes covered by the supplied source. If the source leaves repeated invalid-input behavior unspecified, record the interpretation; any distinct valid counteroffer still needs its own complete readback and later consent. Audit expectations remain separate from source obligations. Test the boundary independently from business-day, holiday and deadline arithmetic.

anchor.exact_paragraph: When a later repair phase provides official case failures/transcripts, diagnose the actual root cause: mapping, routing, code exception, missing policy, honesty, or latency. Fix only the generated files in this run. Do not tune to known customer identities, exact expected records, or fixed dates from the test set. Maintain general behavior from the bank evidence. API dry-run rejection is feedback too. Make the smallest coherent correction and regenerate coverage.

operations.text: Before claiming a repair, keep separate evidence for actual extractor output, decoded controller behavior under persistent variables, bank receipts/ledger, actor adherence, judge agreement and infrastructure completeness. Preserve original scores, scripts, expected records and failed judges with exact source/version pointers. Local literal-event checks do not qualify the producer or hosted sandbox, and missing repetitions are unobserved. Retain mandatory opening disclosures when a judge confuses them with write acknowledgements. Reuse invariant controls against the current run's source-derived policy; do not embed witness customer values or practice calendar constants into this shared guide.
